history_summary: Record ten species-reference GTDB correspondences and two complete ambiguity lists for Barley DT descriptors.
history_details: The pinned native crosswalk supports ten reference mappings and complete Mesorhizobium ciceri and Priestia megaterium alternatives across twelve selected descriptors. Preserve all sixteen B-coded study isolates, partial 16S reference accessions and source stock notes. B7/B14 duplicate-reference conflicts, cultivation timing and the existing full-review findings remain unresolved; reference populations do not identify study assemblies or establish viable persistence. Rounded fractions 0.85 and 0.94 are not inferred exact numerators or inoculum abundance. Four native-null descriptors, both biological nodes, all source quotations, wheat/challenge distinctions and old history remain unchanged. Database label differences are not formal nomenclatural rulings. Only ten blocks, twelve statuses, two option lists and two native inline events changed. Crosswalk release and chronology remain unestablished. This partial technical correction does not complete scientific review or corpus QC.
